text:
alex: Quick ping — PR #4822 is a small Terraform change to add environment tags to the GPU pool subnets. E2E NAT test is failing in CI, and I think missing tags prevent the NAT gateway route creation. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwoodinc/infrastructure/pull/4822 :pray:

maria: @alex saw the PR, will review in ~30m :eyes:

sam: quick skim — two things:
1) the `tags` block is added to `aws_subnet` but you used `merge` var instead of `local.common_tags` which could duplicate.
2) CI failure log shows `Error: resource not found when creating route` which matches missing `aws_nat_gateway` dependency

jeff: pinging @infra-team for an extra pair. I can take a look after standup.

alex: thx. here's the failing command output:
```
Error: InvalidRoute: The route could not be created because the NAT gateway id 'nat-xxxxxxxx' was not found
```

maria: small suggestion — change tags to:
```
tags = merge(local.common_tags, { "redwood:env" = var.env })
```
Also add `depends_on = [aws_nat_gateway.gpu]` to the route resource to avoid ordering flakiness.

sam: Agreed. Also run `make tffmt` to fix formatting in subnet module.

alex: updated the branch with Maria's suggestions. CI re-run queued: https://ci.redwood.dev/4822 :rocket:

deploy-bot: e2e-nat/parallel failed on first run — rerun in progress

tara: If CI is green, I'd approve. We need this for the Dedicated GPU rollout tomorrow. Could someone do a quick approval so I can merge before 11am PST? :clock10:

maria: approved — minor, safe to merge after green CI :white_check_mark:

sam: approved as well :+1:

alex: thanks all. I'll merge once CI completes.

deploy-bot: e2e-nat/parallel passed on rerun — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

alex: merged and deployed to staging. Monitoring :bar_chart:

jeff: saw the staging smoke — no regressions on NAT. Nice one everyone :clap:

alex: backport to prod plan — schedule at 10:30am PST with maintenance window. I'll post in #incidents if anything funky.

tara: sounds good, thanks!
